description: AI Toolbox lifecycle hooks for Claude Code.

hooks.command: echo 'MANDATORY ACTION: Always use the orchestrator-agent. If the user ran /ai-toolbox:deliver-task or /ai-toolbox:bug-fix, or asked to run the task as a workflow, launch the matching ai-toolbox workflow with the Workflow tool from the main session (subagents cannot launch workflows). Call mcp__ai__toolbox__nkn_recall at the start of relevant tasks. As soon as the orchestrator classifies the request, write its intent on a line of its own in the form [ai-toolbox] intent=<intent> using the orchestrator intent name; token usage is tagged from that line, so never write it for a guess. For significant decisions, automatically decide whether to call mcp__ai__toolbox__nkn_learn. Requests to create or extend components, build POCs from existing components, or find reusable components (design_component) run the ai-toolbox design-system workflow by default (/ai-toolbox:design-system); it never commits, pushes, or opens a PR.'
